characters.name: ORAV OTT
characters.description: Väike pruun orav suurte kohevate kõrvade ja sabaga, kandmas väikest sinist lühikeste varrukatega särki ja lühikesi pruune pükse. Tal on suured rõõmsad silmad ja sõbralik naeratus. Armas multifilmistiil.

characters.name: JÄNES LIISA
characters.description: Väike hall jänes pikkade kõrvadega, kandmas väikest kollast kleiti valgete täppidega. Tal on roosa nina, suured uudishimulikud silmad ja leebe naeratus. Armas multifilmistiil.

locations.name: RAND
locations.description: Sunny sandy beach with gentle blue ocean water in the background. Clear blue sky with a few fluffy white clouds. A few smooth, colorful pebbles and empty seashells scattered on the golden sand. No specific plants or large rocks. Soft, inviting atmosphere. Cartoon style.

pages.text: ORAV OTT JA JÄNES LIISA ON RANNAS.
pages.scene: Orav Ott, a small brown squirrel, and Jänes Liisa, a small gray hare, are standing on a sunny sandy beach. The gentle blue ocean water is in the background under a clear blue sky. Both characters are looking around happily. A few pebbles and empty seashells are on the sand near their feet. Cartoon style.

Orav Ott and Jänes Liisa are standing on the sunny sandy beach, looking at a pile of sand with excited and thoughtful expressions. They are gesturing towards the sand as if planning. The gentle blue ocean water is in the background under a clear blue sky. A few pebbles and empty seashells are on the sand. Cartoon style.

Orav Ott, the small brown squirrel, is kneeling on the sunny sandy beach. He is enthusiastically digging into a large pile of sand with a small blue shovel, creating a mound. Jänes Liisa, the small gray hare, stands nearby, watching him with a happy smile. The ocean is in the background. Cartoon style.

Jänes Liisa, the small gray hare, is walking on the sunny sandy beach, carefully carrying a small red bucket full of blue seawater. She is smiling. In the background, Orav Ott continues to dig sand. The ocean is visible. Cartoon style.

Orav Ott and Jänes Liisa are both kneeling on the sunny sandy beach, working together to build a sandcastle. They are carefully patting wet sand to form a tall, central tower. The red bucket and blue shovel are lying on the sand next to them. The ocean is in the background. Cartoon style.

Orav Ott, the small brown squirrel, is carefully examining the sand near the edge of the water on the sunny sandy beach. He is holding a small, smooth, colorful pebble in his paw, looking for more. In the background, the sandcastle with its tall tower is visible. Cartoon style.

Jänes Liisa, the small gray hare, is bending down on the sunny sandy beach. She is holding up a beautiful, colorful seashell with a joyful expression, having just found it. The sandcastle with its tower is visible in the middle ground. Cartoon style.

Orav Ott and Jänes Liisa are standing proudly beside their finished sandcastle on the sunny sandy beach. The sandcastle has a tall tower and is decorated with the colorful pebbles and seashells they collected. Both characters are smiling at their creation. The ocean is in the background. Cartoon style.

pages.text: NAD ON OMA LOSSI ÜLE RÕÕMSAD.
pages.scene: Orav Ott and Jänes Liisa are sitting next to their beautiful decorated sandcastle on the sunny sandy beach. They are both smiling widely, leaning against each other slightly, looking at the castle with great satisfaction and happiness. The ocean is in the background. Cartoon style.

Orav Ott and Jänes Liisa are playfully running and chasing each other a short distance from their magnificent sandcastle on the sunny sandy beach. The sun is shining brightly, casting soft shadows. They both have joyful, energetic expressions. The sandcastle and the ocean are in the background. Cartoon style.
